name: Pick Fields
description: Keep only some fields of every record — the columns of an export, the fields an API may see, a lighter payload for a page. fields is a list or a comma-separated text.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const keys = Array.isArray(fields) ? fields : String(fields ?? '').split(',').map((f) => f.trim()).filter(Boolean); return (items || []).map((it) => Object.fromEntries(keys.map((k) => [k, it == null ? undefined : it[k]]))); })() }}"}]
